findings.title: kernel.md specifies a "plus that remote's tracking refs" push baseline the hook deliberately rejects and a RED case pins against
`%(refname:short)` can yield `heads/<name>` when a tag shares a branch name, so `refs/heads/$b` misses and the branch is silently skipped
the tip-leg refusal asserts "the remote does not already hold those commits" even when it holds them under another ref
